subject: AWS Marketplace — Offer copy, badging, and SKU details
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS CoSell Team <cosell@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding checklist + badging questions

Hi Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks for lining up Redwood's new Offer. To keep the listing sprint moving, a few items we need from your side this week:

1) Final product page copy (short one-liner + 2-3 sentence overview + 3 bullet value props). We prefer concise, customer-centric language—avoid operational detail in the hero.
2) Clarify Offer type: SaaS (metered) vs. AMI vs. SaaS (subscription). This affects SKU design.
3) Proposed SKUs & pricing units (per-hour vCPU-min, monthly seat, GB of embedding). A sample CSV helps.
4) High-res logos and at least one 16:9 hero image (PNG/JPG).
5) Are you requesting any AWS Badges? If so, specify (AWS ISV Accelerate, AWS Competency, Co-Sell Ready).

I attached the marketplace onboarding template to this thread and linked the co-sell intake form (DocuSign) below. If you want, we can schedule a 30m sync to walk through the SKU options.

Onboarding template: marketplace_onboarding_template_v2.pdf (attached)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/CoSellAgreement/XXXX-YYYY

Quick Q: for the 1-line, is it OK to call Redwood a "developer-first inference platform" on the marketplace page? That phrase is fine for us internally but want to confirm it maps to AWS copy guidelines.

Cheers,
Aisha
Aisha Patel
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>; Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding checklist + badging questions

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the checklist. Attaching a first-pass product page draft (redwood_offer_page_v1.docx) and an initial SKU/pricing CSV.

Answers inline:
- One-liner: "Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference platform for predictable, low-latency production." (open to wording tweaks)
- Offer type: SaaS (metered) with an option for reserved monthly commitments (we'll supply both a metered SKU and a committed SKU).
- Proposed SKUs: see sku-pricing-table.csv attached. Primary unit = vGPU-hour for metered; committed SKU is monthly capacity block. We also have an embedding-only SKU billed per-1M tokens.
- Badges: We'd like to request Co-Sell Ready and ISV Accelerate only (we are still finalizing competency applications).

A couple of asks for you:
1) Is the "developer-first" line safe? If AWS prefers neutral language, we can change to "engineer-first" or simply "high-performance".
2) For co-sell badging, does Co-Sell Ready need a separate registration beyond the DocuSign?

Karthik / Grace — looping you both for SKU/pricing accuracy and any product copy edits.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_offer_page_v1.docx; sku-pricing-table.csv; logo_assets_202605.zip

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>; Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@amazon.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding checklist + badging questions

Hi all — quick notes on the SKU file I attached:
- Metered SKU (REDWOOD-MTR-VGPU): billed per vGPU-hour, rate = $8.50/vGPU-hr (example). Includes model variants (gpt-medium/gpt-large) as a single SKU with metered usage breakdown in the usage report.
- Committed SKU (REDWOOD-CMM-1): monthly block of 1,000 vGPU-hours with a discounted effective rate. Customers can tier to larger blocks (2k, 5k).
- Embedding SKU (REDWOOD-EMB-1M): billed per 1M tokens.

Notes / constraints:
- If AWS requires separate SKUs per model family/AMI, we can split later — prefer to keep initial listing simple (single metered + committed + embedding).
- Pricing shown is placeholder; legal pricing approval will come after listing copy sign-off.

Also FYI, the hero line "developer-first" reads fine to me but Grace may want softer customer-facing language.

-Karthik
VP, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

On Thu, May 27, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Aisha — appreciate the checklist. Attaching a first-pass product page draft...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding checklist + badging questions

Quick edit suggestions on the attached doc:
- Hero one-liner tweak: prefer "predictable, low-latency" -> "predictable low-latency inference for production applications" (remove comma). Makes it more search-friendly.
- Value bullets: move cost-control bullet higher and add a short stat about "20–40% cost reduction" when using Redwood Optimize (we should confirm metric later, maybe mark as "typical").
- Technical detail: remove the internal kernel/quantization language from the public bullets — that lives in the technical details section further down.

Also flagged the pricing table for the embedding SKU: the unit should be "per 1M tokens (input+output)" — please confirm billing semantics.

Happy to hop on a 20m call to finalize copy before you send to Aisha.

—Grace
Director, Developer Experience, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>; Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS CoSell Team <cosell@amazon.com>; Ryan Hart <ryan.hart@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding checklist + badging questions

Thanks for the fast turnaround — copy and SKUs look good overall. A few items before we move to publish:

1) Wording: "developer-first" is acceptable per marketplace editorial, but we suggest "developer-first inference platform" -> "developer-first LLM inference platform" for clarity on the listing.
2) Badging: Co-Sell Ready requires the DocuSign plus a short intake in the Partner Central portal. I'll include the Co-Sell intake link in a follow-up email. ISV Accelerate is fine but we'll need evidence of go-to-market plans.
3) Embedding billing: AWS prefers "per-1M input+output tokens" language; please update the SKU CSV to that phrasing.
4) Image requirements: hero image must be 1200x675 px. Your ZIP looks fine, but confirm the hero crop.

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa: update doc per Grace's language tweaks and adjust embedding unit wording.
- Karthik: finalize placeholder pricing tiers so procurement can pre-fill pricing fields.
- Vanessa: complete DocuSign and I'll follow up with Co-Sell intake link and Partner Central action item.

Ryan (cc'd) from Acme Cloud — we spoke about co-sell enablement; if you'd like to be listed as a reference partner on the offer page, we can add a short blurb and link to your case study. Ryan: are you OK with that?

If you want me to schedule a 30m publish readiness call Friday (6/4) midday PT, I can do that.

Best,
Aisha
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
